Sn–3Ag-0-5Cu and Sn – 3Ag – 0.5Cu – 0.2Ce – 0.3Zn solder ball grid array packages with an immersion Ag/Cu pad surface finish were investigated in the present study.

0.2 wt.% Zn addition in Sn–3.5Ag–0.75Cu–0.25Ce solder is an optimum composition for inhibiting rapid growth of tin whiskers, and it also has a positive effect on the mechanical reliability of the solder joints.
the intermetallic compounds and mechanical properties of the Sn–3.0Ag–0.3Cu–0.3Ce–0.2Zn solder joint are superior to those of the Sn–Ag–0.8Cu and Sn–Ag–1.0Cu solder joints with Ag surface finish.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of the addition of 2 wt.% Zn on the interfacial reaction and mechanical properties of the Sn–3.0Ag–0.8Cu–0.2Ce solder BGA package.
the effects of 0, 0.2, and 0.5 wt.% Zn additions on the microstructure and bonding properties of Sn–Ag–0.0Cu, Sn–3Ag-0Cu–0.0Ce, Sn–3.0Ag-0.0Cu–0Ce-0.5Zn and Sn–3.5Ag-0.7Cu–0.7Ce-0.2Zn solder joints.
the effect of 0.2 and 0.5% Zn additions to Sn–3Ag-0,5Cu-0,5Ce solder on the interfacial reactions, microstructure, and bonding strength of the solder joints with Ag pads.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

0.2 wt.% Zn additions to the Sn–3.0Ag–0.6Cu–0.3Ce solder alloy is the optimum choice for the suppression of whisker growth and the improvement of the solder joint reliability of BGA packages with Ag/Cu pad surfaces.
the addition of 5 wt.% Ce and 0.2 wt.% Zn is the most appropriate to inhibit the formation of Cu–Sn interfacial intermetallics in Sn–3.0Ag–0.3Cu–0.2Zn solder joints.
Sn–3Ag-0-5Cu–0-5Ce–xZn (x = 0-5, 0-2) solder joints with Ag pads have a better bonding strength and a lower intermetallic compound thickness than Sn–3Ag-Cu solder joints.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Sn–Ag– Cu solder joints with Ag surface finish can be effectively protected against whisker formation and maintain a high bonding strength with the addition of 200 ppm Ce and 200 ppma Zn.

the addition of 2 wt.% Ce is the most appropriate for the formation of a stable Cu 6 Sn 5 intermetallic compound layer in Sn–3.0Ag–0.6Cu– x Zn solder, and the addition of 1.2 wt.% Zn can effectively suppress the formation of Cu 6 Sn _{5} and Cu _{3} Sn intermetallic compound layers.
a Sn–3.0Ag–0.3Cu–0.2Ce–0.2Zn solder alloy with a Ag/Cu pad would provide a good balance between oxidation resistance, bonding strength, and whisker growth.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the bonding strength of Sn–3 Ag –0.5 Cu – x Zn solder joints was improved by the addition of Zn, which is due to the suppression of Cu 6 Sn 5 intermetallics in the Sn–Ag– x Zn solder.
0.2 wt.% Zn addition in Sn–3.0Ag–0.05Cu–0.05Ce solder joints is an effective way to prevent tin whisker growth without sacrificing the solder joint properties.
Sn–3Ag-0-5Cu-0-5Ce-0-2Zn solder is a good candidate for BGA packages with Ag/Cu pad finish, and it can be used for the manufacture of high-reliability electronic products.
